title: Dragon and the Frog Prince
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a glossy black-skinned figure with golden facial markings and yellow eyes intertwined with a vibrant green and gold serpentine dragon. To the right stands a pure white figure with horns and long lashes, while a glowing green frog holds a golden orb beside a wooden sign reading 'THE END'.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a glossy obsidian black humanoid with golden facial markings and bright yellow eyes, wrapped by a long vibrant green and gold patterned Chinese dragon. Beside them stands a stark white horned feminine figure with dramatic eyelashes. In the foreground a detailed green frog holds a glowing golden orb next to a wooden sign that reads 'THE END'. Background shows snow-capped mountains, a castle on a cliff, purple starry sky with crescent moon, and yellow wildflowers in the foreground.
